beaches.name: Tzanaki
beaches.summary: The pebble coves south of Livadia are in use as the island's naturist beach. A naturist directory carries consistent reports from 2007 to 2018, with a signposted path from the road; a 2011 press mention called it a nudist beach. No formal designation is documented.

beaches.name: Vatses
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is reported at the southern side, away from the beach bar. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 2013 and 2018 describing a roughly half-nude mix with topless common on the textile side; no designation or signage is documented.
